title: Star Trek Dual Style
style_tags: Photorealistic canonical live-action Star Trek comparison. LEFT is the original/Prime screen persona; RIGHT is the exact canonical Mirror, assimilated, corrupted, possessed or duplicate persona of the same character and same recognizable screen performer. Preserve each persona's canonical face, hair, facial hair, makeup, prosthetics, uniform, insignia, accessories and props. Both figures share one continuous cinematic Star Trek environment with no split panel.

episode_summaries.notes: First episode with no pre-existing series-owned dual-style refs for any pair — Storyboarder generated and registered 4 fresh pair-references (sisko-mirrorsisko, bashir-mirrorbashir, quark-mirrorquark, seven-borgseven) from well-documented canonical screen facts, now reusable. Post-approval patch: original amix(normalize=0) had no final limiter/loudnorm pass, causing audible peak spikes — fixed by adding alimiter+loudnorm after the mix; re-encoded with libx264 software encoder instead of h264_videotoolbox to rule out hardware-encoder artifacts. Added an opt-in pop-up promo banner (branding/banner-st1.png) on scene 1 per user request; user noted the banner can be ~2x larger next time.
